items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And I found myself on the bandstand at 13 years old with musicians that were professional level players. In fact the drummer, Martin Drew, was a huge Oscar Peterson fan.

ctx.x: Can I ask you how you learned about —

I played — there was a local band leader, a trumpet player, who kind of mentored me. He wasn’t really a trained musician but he was one of those local kind of semi-professional guys. And he had a quite successful little combo that played weddings and corporate events and stuff. And I found myself on the bandstand at 13 years old with musicians that were professional level players. In fact the drummer, Martin Drew, was a huge Oscar Peterson fan. And eventually he became Oscar Peterson’s drummer in the U.K. And I…
The circle will get you around.
